_comment: CaImAn pipeline template. Copy alongside <session>_pipeline.py and rename both. The session name is derived from the script filename — do not add session_id here.

env._comment: Applied before any caiman import. CAIMAN_* vars are forced; thread counts use setdefault so shell values take precedence. Note: CAIMAN_TILE_N and CAIMAN_TILE_SLOTS are recomputed at runtime when running in SHM mode (template_pipeline.py L322-324), so any value set here is only consulted during bootstrap.

data._comment: fr: acquisition frame rate [Hz]. decay_time: GCaMP decay constant [s] (GCaMP6f≈0.4, GCaMP6s≈1.0). dxy: pixel size in microns [row, col] - forwarded into CNMFParams.data; set per-objective. add_baseline: constant added to all pixels during F→C conversion to keep values >0 for stable dF/F. n_channels / n_planes: propagated from acquisition YAML by new_session.py. channel_id: 0-based index of the channel this pipeline analyses (set per-channel when n_channels > 1).

motion_correction._comment: pw_rigid: piecewise-rigid MC (false=rigid, recommended for most 2P). max_shifts: [row, col] px. border_nan: 'copy' replicates border pixels; 'min' fills with movie minimum.

cnmf._comment: See docs/configuration.md for full parameter descriptions. Ring constraint: ring_size_factor × gSiz[0] must be < rf.
cnmf._comment_derived: WARNING: nb_patch, del_duplicates, and normalize_init values declared here are IGNORED by build_cnmf_opts when method_init=corr_pnr. nb_patch is forced to 0; del_duplicates is forced to (gnb==0); normalize_init is forced to False. They are kept in the template for visibility only.
cnmf._comment_seeding: SEEDING SEMANTICS (corr_pnr init): (a) K MUST be an explicit integer per patch. K=null falls back to caiman/source_extraction/cnmf/initialization.py:1846 max_number = patch_pixels/5, which is hundreds of components per patch and paves the FOV with noise fits. Use caiman.utils.params_estimator.estimate_params for a data-driven K. (b) min_pnr is INTERNALLY RESCALED by sqrt(tsub) inside greedyROI_corr (initialization.py:1282). Setting min_pnr=6.0 with tsub=2 means the seeding gate uses min_pnr=6.0*sqrt(2)≈8.49 internally. (c) The actual seeding gate is the PRODUCT min_corr*min_pnr (initialization.py:1861 min_v_search = min_corr*min_pnr). Both individual thresholds AND the product matter — setting one tight and the other loose does not behave like setting one of them at the product value.

quality._comment: Components must pass all enabled criteria. use_cnn is auto-disabled if model files are missing. *_lowest fields are the hard-reject floors (a component below SNR_lowest, rval_lowest, or cnn_lowest is unconditionally rejected, even if it passes the upper thresholds).

cluster._comment: n_processes: null=auto (all CPUs). Reduce ram_budget_frac if workers OOM. Lower worker_overhead_frac if actual worker RAM < estimated. worker_overhead_frac: multiplier on analytical RAM estimate per worker (default 1.6). Lower to allow more workers when empirical RSS < estimate. ram_budget_frac: fraction of total RAM available for workers after reserving movie+parent.

gpu._comment: precompute_chunk_frames: frames per GPU filter chunk. Peak VRAM ≈ 2 × frames × d1 × d2 × 4 bytes. Reduce if GPU OOM during precompute.
gpu._comment_mc: mc_batch_size: GPU frames per MC batch. null = auto (uses 85% of free VRAM). Set an int to cap (e.g. 2000 for 16 GB GPUs).

noise_correction._comment: Streaming noise correction via utilities/noise. Runs the noise diagnostic on the raw stack, builds a recipe from flagged sources at or above min_level, applies via streaming wrapper (peak RAM ~ chunk_frames × d1 × d2 × 4 bytes). Skipped if the diagnostic finds nothing actionable, so safe to leave enabled. Writes <session>_Ncorrected.tif used for all downstream steps. Runs BEFORE xcorr_correction.

support._comment: SUPPORT self-supervised denoising (utilities/support, vendored from NICALab/SUPPORT). Operates on the C-order mmap produced by stage 3 (F→C conversion), so this stage works uniformly for both MSR-source and TIFF-source pipelines — the mmap is the canonical internal format past stage 3. Writes a new C-order mmap with '_SUPPORTdenoised' in the name; Yr/images are rebound to it for every downstream stage (4b detrend, 4c SHM, 5 seeding, 6 CNMF, 7 oscillation). Stages 4b and 5 were specifically designed assuming this step ran: SUPPORT preserves the photobleach ramp (4b detrends it) and saturates the Cn image (5 falls back to anatomical seeding). Requires a pre-trained checkpoint; train via 'python -m utilities.support train ...' once per scope+gain configuration, then point all sessions at the same checkpoint. Memory: copies the mmap into a contiguous RAM buffer of ~4·n_px·T bytes (~19 GB for 18540×512×512 float32) for efficient patch sampling.
support._comment_paths: Model lookup: either set `checkpoint` to a .pth path (sidecar JSON next to it gives the architecture automatically; shipped pretrained models without a sidecar fall back to the default architecture matching bs3.pth), OR set `exp_name` + `results_dir` to auto-find the latest checkpoint of a training run (pin a specific epoch with `epoch`).
support._comment_edges: include_edges='mirror' (default): the (input_frames-1)//2 frames at each stack end are extrapolated via mirror padding so the output mmap preserves the input T (drop-in compatible with the rest of the pipeline). 'repeat' uses edge-frame replication. 'none' drops the boundary frames and writes a shorter mmap (T - 2·pad); downstream stages adapt to the new T but tracking frame-time alignment becomes the user's problem.
support._comment_cache: The pipeline writes <stem>_SUPPORTdenoised_cnmf_*.mmap.support.json next to the output mmap. If a later run finds the mmap with mtime newer than the input cnmf mmap AND the sidecar recipe matches the current checkpoint + patch_size + patch_interval + batch_size + include_edges + dims + T, the cached mmap is reused (no GPU work). To force rebuild, delete the _SUPPORTdenoised mmap from CAIMAN_TEMP.

xcorr_correction._comment: Bidirectional line-scan phase correction (resonant/galvo-resonant scanners). Set enabled=true when even/odd row misalignment is visible.

oscillation._comment: Multitaper (DPSS) oscillation analysis run after CNMF on the accepted component traces and neuropil background. enabled=true runs OscillationAnalyzer.run_all and saves a QC figure. NW: DPSS time-bandwidth product (2=fine resolution, 4=low variance). win_s: spectrogram window length in seconds (Delta_f ~ 2*NW/win_s). overlap_s: window overlap in seconds; null = win_s/2 (50%). adaptive: use adaptive taper weighting (recommended). use_gpu: accelerate via CuPy when available.

detrend._comment: Per-pixel polynomial temporal detrend applied to the movie before Cn/CNMF. Removes the slow brightness-decay ramp (photobleaching) that SUPPORT preserves; also de-saturates the local-correlation image. order=1 linear; 2-3 for curved bleach decay. preserve_mean keeps F0 so dF/F stays stable. use_gpu runs the regression via CuPy (two matmuls + tiny solve per pixel-chunk) with NumPy fallback. Written back to the C-order mmap; fast transients are untouched.

seeding._comment: Anatomical seeding for census-complete extraction. Detection runs AFTER motion correction (registered frames — unregistered movies smear somata and ruin the projection). segmenter: 'watershed' (deterministic, model-free skimage; no GPU/weights; tune via min_distance/threshold_rel/smooth_sigma) or 'cellpose' (Cellpose-SAM, needs cellpose>=4). projection: 'percentile' (recommended for low-baseline GCaMP; set percentile=90 or a list like [80,90,95] averaged), or 'std'/'max'/'mean'/'max_div_mean' (mean has little soma contrast here). nb = global full-FOV background for the seeded single-FOV fit (1-2). Seeding BYPASSES corr_pnr/min_corr. Truly-silent cells are invisible to any functional projection — a complete inactive-cell census needs a structural channel. Inspect *_seed_projection.npy / *_seed_labels.npy.
